assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent furniture sprite atlas for a cozy hand-painted 2.5D office game RoomCrew. Reference image is ONLY a painting style and sage/oak palette reference, not its irregular perspective. Produce EXACTLY TWO separate desks, left and right, each fully isolated with generous transparent gutters, no other objects, no people or chairs. Actual alpha transparent background. Each desk uses the SAME strictly orthographic 2:1 dimetric camera: all floor-aligned parallel edges have slopes +0.5 or -0.5, all verticals perfectly vertical, no vanishing points, no Dutch tilt, no leaning monitor or legs. Long desk axis runs from lower-left to upper-right. We see the FRONT working side of both desks facing lower-right, a seated operator would be at the lower-right and look upper-left / northwest toward the display. SAME perspective and proportions for both. Left: clean modern personal work desk, light oak rectangular top with gently rounded corners, slim straight warm-gray legs, compact sage drawer pedestal only at the FAR LEFT, large unobstructed knee space at right half, one upright slim dark monitor at back center with a simple pale blue calm screen, a flat keyboard aligned with desktop at front center, mouse to its right, just one pencil cup, no clutter. Right: matching security service desk of the SAME size, identical desk silhouette and leg/knee-space arrangement, one upright monitor with understated pale blue status shapes, a tiny small shield symbol on screen and a closed small notebook. Calm office design, no sci-fi effects, no glow, no hologram, no giant server console. Whole desk including monitor to feet should have modest compact vertical proportions suitable for chibi characters. Crisp refined hand-painted linework, soft restrained shadows on objects only, clean white/oak/sage colors, consistent warm light upper-left. Do not draw floor, cast shadow, text, labels, icons floating outside monitor, chair, characters, background, frame, UI, perspective warping, uneven legs, or tilted screens. Balanced two-column sprite atlas, landscape image.
